sources.title: GLiNER2.5 Small V1 | AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: GLiNER2.5 Small is a 74M parameter span free information extraction model that predicts entity boundaries directly instead of enumerating candidate spans, enabling linear scaling with document length. It performs named entity recognition, relation extraction, and constrained classification over long documents in a single pass.

sources.title: GLiNER2 family - a fastino Collection - Hugging Face
sources.snippet: GLiNER2 extends the original GLiNER architecture to support multi-task information extraction with a schema-driven interface.

sources.title: Fastino Labs
sources.snippet: GLiNER2.5 replaces span enumeration with a new boundary-prediction architecture, unlocking unlimited span length, long-context extraction, joint entity-relation extraction, constrained classification, and span attributes. Still small, still no GPU required.

sources.title: GLiNER: Generalist and Lightweight Model for Named Entity ... - GitHub
sources.snippet: GLiNER is a framework for training and deploying small Named Entity Recognition (NER) models with zero-shot capabilities. In addition to traditional NER, it supports incremental streaming NER, joint entity and relation extraction, and multi-task token classification.
